name: grasshopper-generator
title: 蚱蜢发电机
description: Generate Rhino 7 Grasshopper (.ghx) XML files from natural language descriptions or images. Build parametric definitions with native GH components, GhPython scripts, and wiring. Supports concept design: twisted towers, curved facades, Voronoi patterns, diagrids, parametric surfaces, mesh operations, and custom Python geometry. Triggers: grasshopper, generate ghx, parametric definition, GH file, grasshopper definition, 参数化, 生成gh文件, when user wants a .ghx file.
